Location.description: Path of the newly created Zone.

schema.description: A behavioral classification scoped to a Site, bundling the Area and Zone code segments into one aggregate.

zoneId.description: `SITE-AREA-ZONE` — the first three segments of every LocationCode inside it.

siteCode.description: The Site this zone is scoped to.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Whether the zone is rated for hazardous materials.

status.description: The lifecycle state shared by every structural aggregate. Decommission is one-way in v1. UnderMaintenance is a legal persisted state that the read models render; no v1 use case sets it.
status.title: Status

bayPitchM.description: The zone's effective bay pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.2 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated-distance fallback when aisle centreline geometry is missing.

levelPitchM.description: The zone's effective level pitch (ADR-0017): the explicit override when one was set at registration, else the service default (1.5 m). Used only by the travel graph's estimated vertical spacing between adjacent levels.

schema.title: Zone

400.description: Malformed input, or the Idempotency-Key header is absent or empty (ADR 0019).

schema.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details. Every error response in this API uses this shape.

type.description: A URI identifying the error CATEGORY. It is an identifier, not a link — it does not need to resolve.

title.description: A fixed, human-readable summary of the error category.
title.example: Location type is not legal in this zone

status.description: The HTTP status code, duplicated in the body per RFC 7807.

detail.description: The specific message for this occurrence.
detail.example: location type violates a placement rule for this zone: Shelf is denied in zone WH1-STOR-FRZ by rule [RULE-FRZ-NO-SHELF: Deny Shelf where temperatureClass=Frozen]

instance.description: The request path that produced the error.

schema.title: Problem

value.title: Malformed location code
value.detail: location code must have exactly 7 hyphen-joined segments (site-area-zone-aisle-bay-level-position): got 4 segments in "WH1-STOR-AMB-A07"

value.title: Idempotency-Key header is required
value.detail: This endpoint creates a new resource on every call and requires a caller-supplied Idempotency-Key header so a retried request is never applied twice.
